description: This file defines the IOSGatewayChatTransport struct which implements the OpenClawChatTransport protocol for iOS. It provides methods to manage chat sessions, send messages, request history, and handle server events, acting as a bridge between the app and a gateway server via asynchronous network requests.

classes.name: IOSGatewayChatTransport
classes.description: A struct implementing chat transport functionalities for iOS using a gateway session.

methods.name: abortRun
methods.description: Asynchronously aborts a chat run given a session key and run ID.

methods.name: listSessions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of chat sessions with optional limit.

methods.name: setActiveSessionKey
methods.description: Set active session key (empty implementation for operator clients).

methods.name: resetSession
methods.description: Resets a chat session identified by session key.

methods.name: compactSession
methods.description: Compacts a chat session to optimize storage.

methods.name: requestHistory
methods.description: Fetches chat history payload for a given session.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a chat message with optional attachments, logs activity, and returns a response.

methods.name: requestHealth
methods.description: Checks health status of the gateway, with timeout.

methods.name: events
methods.description: Streams real-time chat-related events from the server.
